annotations.title: Verify Perpetual / Spot Trade Thesis (DJZS pre-execution audit)

description: Deterministic pre-execution audit of a perpetual or spot TRADE thesis (direction, size, leverage, entry, stop, target, venue, and the REASON), run before capital is committed. USE THIS TOOL before opening, sizing, or increasing any perpetual or spot position. Returns PASS / WAIT / FAIL with a reproducible verdict hash. A position stated with no thesis FAILS (DJZS-S01); an unbounded position FAILS (DJZS-X01); an unresolvable stop or thesis WAITs. Prediction-market bets are refused here (use verify_pm_trade) and are not charged. Price 2.00 USDC per audit on Base.

agent_address.description: Optional agent wallet (0x). If set, this audit updates that agent's on-chain DJZS trust score

bracket.description: Optional exact bracket (side, entry, stop, target, taker_fee_bps, optional hit_rate_pct / funding_rate_8h / sigma_annual). Returns the break-even hit rate in the non-scoring mechanics block; never enters the verdict or its hash

funding_rate_8h.description: Funding rate per 8 hours as a fraction (0.0001 = 0.01%); longs pay a positive rate. Counted only with sigma_annual

hit_rate_pct.description: The thesis's stated probability, in percent, that the target prints before the stop

sigma_annual.description: Annualized volatility as a fraction (0.45 = 45%); sets the expected hold, and so the funding paid

taker_fee_bps.description: The venue's taker fee in basis points, charged on entry and on exit

intent.description: Free-text perpetual or spot trade thesis to audit: direction, size, leverage, entry, stop, target, venue, and the REASON

target_system.description: Optional agent/project identifier. Written to the certificate ONLY with a matching target_system_subject + target_system_signature; unsigned values are DISCARDED, not stored

target_system_signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign over "DJZS-TSC-1 target-system claim\nsubject: <lowercased subject>\ntarget_system: <value>"

target_system_subject.description: Address that signed the target_system claim. Must be the address that recovers from target_system_signature
